args.query: FROM logs-windows.sysmon-default METADATA _id, _index | WHERE event.code == "1" AND (TO_LOWER(process.command_line) LIKE "*login data*" OR TO_LOWER(process.command_line) LIKE "*logins.json*" OR TO_LOWER(process.command_line) LIKE "*cookies*" OR TO_LOWER(process.command_line) LIKE "*google*chrome*user data*" OR TO_LOWER(process.command_line) LIKE "*microsoft*edge*user data*" OR TO_LOWER(process.command_line) LIKE "*mozilla*firefox*profiles*") | KEEP @timestamp, host.name, user.name, process.executable, process.command_line, _id, _index

purpose: Processes referencing browser credential stores (Login Data, logins.json, Chrome/Edge/Firefox profile paths).

args.query: FROM logs-windows.sysmon-default METADATA _id, _index | WHERE event.code == "11" AND (TO_LOWER(file.path) LIKE "*login data*" OR TO_LOWER(file.path) LIKE "*logins.json*" OR TO_LOWER(file.path) LIKE "*google*chrome*user data*" OR TO_LOWER(file.path) LIKE "*microsoft*edge*user data*" OR TO_LOWER(file.path) LIKE "*mozilla*firefox*profiles*") | KEEP @timestamp, host.name, user.name, file.path, process.executable, _id, _index

purpose: File creations/copies of browser credential-store files.

args.query: FROM logs-windows.sysmon-default METADATA _id, _index | WHERE event.code == "10" AND (TO_LOWER(win.TargetImage) LIKE "*chrome*" OR TO_LOWER(win.TargetImage) LIKE "*msedge*" OR TO_LOWER(win.TargetImage) LIKE "*firefox*") | KEEP @timestamp, host.name, user.name, process.executable, win.TargetImage, win.GrantedAccess, _id, _index

purpose: Process memory access to browser processes, used to extract saved passwords from memory.

args.query: event.code:4663 AND (win.ObjectName:*Login Data* OR win.ObjectName:*logins.json* OR win.ObjectName:*Chrome* OR win.ObjectName:*Firefox* OR win.ObjectName:*Edge*)

purpose: Object-access auditing on browser credential-store files.

args.query: FROM logs-windows.powershell-default METADATA _id, _index | WHERE event.code == "4104" AND (TO_LOWER(powershell.script_block_text) LIKE "*login data*" OR TO_LOWER(powershell.script_block_text) LIKE "*logins.json*" OR TO_LOWER(powershell.script_block_text) LIKE "*chrome*user data*" OR TO_LOWER(powershell.script_block_text) LIKE "*firefox*profiles*") | KEEP @timestamp, host.name, user.name, powershell.script_block_text, _id, _index
